name: SIM list search filters results correctly
description: When a user types a search query in the SIMs list, only matching SIMs are displayed.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the login page and log in as manager
Navigate to the SIMs management page
Note the total number of SIMs displayed
Type a partial ICCID or phone number in the search field
Verify the list filters to show only SIMs matching the search query
Verify all SIMs are displayed again after clearing the search
